$comment: Canonical extension inventory for the pi harness. verify-harness.mjs derives its section [1]/[2] truth tables (expected extension files, lib modules, forks, folded markers, npm packages, vendored deps) from THIS file — retire an extension by removing it here AND deleting the file on disk, never by editing verify-harness.mjs. Deleted/retired components are tombstoned in retired[] below (machine-readable, one entry per component); verify-harness.mjs section [9] flags any doc/script reference to a retired name that is not a deletion record, and any retired file that reappears on disk. If a retired component returns, register it deliberately in extensions[]/lib[]/forks[]/npmPackages[] AND remove it from retired[]. npmPackages[] is EMPTY since the 2026-08-31 fork completion: every former third-party extension is a local fork under extensions/ and settings.json packages[] must stay empty (the YunusPi-owned core and extensions update only from YunusPi source). vendoredDeps[] = the exact-pinned runtime dependency root agent/npm/package.json must contain (imported by the forks via the extensions/node_modules symlink).
